meta.name: boss-zhipin-scraper
meta.description: Scrape BOSS直聘 (job listing site) via Chrome CDP. Searches jobs by keyword/city/filters, fetches JD details, outputs structured JSON/CSV with plaintext salary, and can summarize scraped results into a job-market prompt. Use when user wants to search/analyze jobs on BOSS直聘 or zhipin.com.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抓取招聘网站岗位信息,按城市与关键词整理成结构化表格数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 想批量搜集招聘岗位并分析薪资与需求趋势
copy.tagline_en: Scrape job postings by city and keyword into structured salary data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to gather job listings in bulk and analyze salary and demand

howto.what: Claude 会通过 Chrome CDP 连接专用浏览器,按关键词、城市和筛选条件抓取 BOSS直聘 职位列表与 JD 详情,输出含明文薪资的 JSON/CSV,并可生成聚合摘要和求职材料优化提示词。
howto.when: 当你想在 BOSS直聘 上搜索或分析职位时触发。首次使用会先做环境检查,依赖、CDP 连通或登录不通过时,会引导你启动专用浏览器并登录。

howto.what_en: Claude connects to a dedicated Chrome over CDP, scrapes BOSS直聘 job listings and JD details by keyword, city and filters, and outputs JSON/CSV with plaintext salary. It can also summarize results into a job-market prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to search or analyze jobs on BOSS直聘 (zhipin.com). First run checks environment, and guides you to start a dedicated browser and log in if CDP or login fails.

say_en.text: Search AI Agent jobs in Shanghai, scrape 3 pages
say_en.note: Checks env, then scrapes and writes JSON

say_en.text: Summarize the jobs I just scraped into a job-market report
Use CSV format and fetch 8 job details
say_en.note: Also exports list and detail CSV files
